sentences.text: 3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that in the initial crime, the applicant is already protected by granting ad-interim protection by observing that immediate custodial interrogation is not required.
It is further observed that the present applicant was the purchaser and he was not concerned about the false and forged execution of the sale deed.
Considering the same, the applicant was protected by granting ad-interim protection.

He submitted that here also the applicant has not opened any account in the Bank, but it is the co-accused who have opened the said account,
merely because, the cheque book and the passbook were recovered from the present applicant, he is implicated falsely in the alleged offence.
As far as the custodial interrogation is concerned, which is not required.
He further submitted that in fact the cheque book is recovered from the house of the co-accused and not from the present applicant.
Considering the same, he be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

Learned APP strongly opposed the said application on the ground that with common intention to deceive the complainant, present applicant and other co-accused have executed the sale deed by impersonating the original owner.
Thereafter by placing the forged documents on record, opened the account and obtained the facility.

Considering that the present applicant and other co-accused have filed forged documents to open the account in the Bank as well as the facilities of the passbook and cheque book, his custodial interrogation is required and prayed for rejection of the ad-interim protection.
5. Having heard the learned Counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State, perused the recitals of the FIR.
The present applicant is concerned, who is the purchaser and therefore, he is already protected by this Court by granting ad-interim protection.
As far as the allegations are concerned, the account is opened by the co-accused and the cheque book is also recovered from the house of the co-accused.
The immediate custodial interrogation of the present applicant is not required.
In view of that, he can be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass Iman S/O Abdul Rahim Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. Pso Ps ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61412431/

sentences.text:
ORDER (i) In the event of arrest, the applicant Iman s/o Abdul Rahim Khan be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.74/2024 registered with Police (4) 909.aba.261.2024 Station, Dhantoli, District Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467,
468 and 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, on executing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station twice in a week on Monday and Thursday between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.

(iii) The applicant shall furnish his cellphone number and address with the address proof along with the names and address of his two relatives along with the address proof before the Investigating Officer.
(iv) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case.
6. Stand over after two weeks.
(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.) Sarkate Signed by: Mr. A.R. Sarkate Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 17/04/2024 17:03:44
